known_mismatch.reason: An operation that throws inside an array or hash literal (division, modulo, subtraction, unary minus, spread, the values of `set a, b = ...`, hash arguments) is attributed by PHP to an earlier line (the literal's start / its first element), while twig-rs applies the debug marker that a variable on a later Twig line emits in the middle of the expression. It happens with non-strict variables (compiled as `($context['x'] ?? null)`), loop variables and constant right operands (`[]`, `null`, `false`, `(1 - 1)`) also in strict mode; with an ordinary strict variable as the right operand, and outside literals, both report the later line. PHP's rule is its compiler's line bookkeeping (CG(zend_lineno) when the opline is emitted inside zend_compile_array); the exact model needs opcode-level study. Suspected: LLTL line attribution (emit_at) of array/hash literal elements (src/lltl codegen).
